# minipkg

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of minipkg is to get the time

## Installation

You can install the development version of minipkg from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("monikavila/minipkg")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(minipkg)
## Example code: no language
what_time()
## Adding language: en or es 
what_time("en")
```
